title: Eurotunnel Calais Terminal
geometryBasis: Named 20-vertex Eurotunnel Charles Dickens terminal outline, the exact Qualla original dated 19 July 2024 and the LeShuttle operator’s description of its French passenger terminal.
sectionBasis: A low, triangular terminal with a blue-gray clearstory, white panel plinth, twin vestibules and an orange-red canopy carried by white round columns.
limitations: The model covers the Charles Dickens passenger building photographed in July 2024. Adjacent Cité Europe, artwork, advertising and the shuttle tracks are outside its scope.
The mapped frontage line controls the long orange-red canopy. Setback, height, vestibule stations, and the elevations outside the published photograph are visual estimates.
The original terrain is retained. The paved passenger approach, facade floor and individual column contacts have approximate elevations.
